name: Punched Tape Reader
desc: Eight-track paper tape streaming through a photoelectric reader: the sprocket line ticks past like a heartbeat, lamplight pours up through every punched hole as it crosses the gate, the reels breathe and turn at their own radius-dependent rates, and the decoded program spills out as ASCII under the head.

energy.doc: lamp intensity through the holes and specular sheen

density.doc: entropy of the byte stream — sparse opcodes to dense random punch

scale.doc: tape width and reel size vs design size

wear.doc: oil bloom, staining and scuffing on the deck and stock

tilt.doc: angle of the tape run across the deck

hue.doc: deck + tape hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: oiled buff tape on green machine enamel / dry manila stock on a warm deck / radically abstracted — a negative X-ray where the holes are the only light and the tape is a ghost / cold violet fanfold

act.doc: multi-minute programme: a running program / long leader runs and sprocket-only stretches between blocks / dense random punch, maximum entropy
